Question: Why does wspeed differ from sqrt(uas^2 + vas^2) in the LOCA2 hybrid files?
Notes: RESOLVED: wspeed is a separately downscaled/bias-corrected scalar daily-mean speed, not equal to sqrt(uas^2+vas^2) by design; use wspeed directly (D. Pierce, Scripps, R20). The positive offset is the scalar pedestal; the left-skewed tail reflects the differing bias correction of speed vs components.
